content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NCCT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.ncct.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 19-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Council for Cooperative Training (NCCT) for filling up various deputation posts across India.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available under NCCT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Assistant Registrar, Accounts Officer, and Audit Officer, offering a total of 3 vacancies for qualified and experienced candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for NCCT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications for NCCT Recruitment 2026 must be submitted through offline mode by sending the filled application form via post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the offline application form is 19-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is below 56 years as of the closing date of the application process. Check official notification for details.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary provided for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary as per Level-9 in the Pay Matrix (Rs. 53100-167800) under the 7th CPC with usual allowances.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Assistant Registrar?
faq.answer: Officers working in Central/State Government/Autonomous/Statutory Bodies/PSUs/Cooperative Organizations holding analogous posts or with 5 years service in Level 7.

faq.question: Q8. What qualifications are needed for Accounts and Audit Officers?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Chartered Accountants (CA) or Cost & Management Accountants (CMA) with relevant experience in accounts and audit departments.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send the filled offline application form?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent through the proper channel to the Secretary, National Council for Cooperative Training, 3 Siri Institutional Area, August Kranti Marg, Hauz Khas, New Delhi-110 016.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website of NCCT?
faq.answer: The official website of the National Council for Cooperative Training where you can find details and notification is www.ncct.ac.in.
